implementationAudit.nativeBridgeSupport: The production native binary bridge currently returns density, phase-equilibrium pressure, liquid/vapor molar densities, compositions and residual metadata. It does not yet expose complete mixture Helmholtz derivative outputs for Cv, Cp or speed of sound.
implementationAudit.providerSupport: TeqpProvider exposes mixture density plus derived molar mass, specific volume and compressibility factor only, and reports mixture Cv, Cp and speed of sound as unavailable.

productionDecision.reason: Complete ideal/residual derivative implementation, reducing-function derivative verification and independent numerical validation were not completed in this checkpoint. The properties remain independently gated and unavailable rather than being exposed from unvalidated formulas.
